comparison.objective: Open the named fuse holder, replace its blown fuse with the correctly rated spare, and close it securely.
comparison.physical_skill: Component identification, small-part extraction/insertion, and carrier closure.
comparison.success_condition: Correct fuse seated in F2, blown fuse in the tray, holder passes a pull check; opening neighboring holders or fitting the wrong rating invalidates the trial.
comparison.reason: Tests identification-sensitive electrical component replacement, not bulk physical separation.
